provenance.redactionPolicy: V1: wallet roots, peer IDs, and referenced key IDs replaced by deterministic fixture-local ordinal aliases that preserve source lexicographic rank; record/root aliases are mutually bound; only exact allowlisted profile subject shapes and predicates retained; unknown or underived nested subjects rejected before serialization; literal values omitted but UTF-8 byte lengths retained; aliases and per-record shape/byte counts may be correlated with the public agents graph; no tokens, keys, multiaddrs, names, raw identifiers, or hashes of identifiers stored
